articles.title: Herido de gravedad el vallenatero hijo de Poncho Zuleta y 20 músicos al estrellarse el bus donde iban contra un puente sobre el río Ariguaní
articles.en: Vallenato singer, son of Poncho Zuleta, and 20 musicians seriously injured after the bus they were traveling in crashed into a bridge over the Ariguaní River
